reviews.text: I take my dog rave there for the past year every three weeks, the lady is very knowledgeable , she take good care of the dog hair and style and sometimes if she noticed some irritation on the skin or pimples or whatever she make sure to tell me so I can check with the vet if there is something I need to do about it, which I very much appreciated.

Amazing grooming salon! Karolina is truly the best. Our Bichon Frisé, Yuki, is a regular. She gets groomed every 6-8 weeks. She grooms nicely, quickly, and is very sweet! Super happy with her. Yuki is back out within 1.5 hours! Very nice! ❤️🍀

I honestly couldn’t be happier with this dog groomer. My dog, Oden, always comes out looking incredibly clean, completely free of tangles, and smelling amazing.

What makes it even more special is that Oden usually hates going to the groomer. We’ve tried several places before, and it was always stressful for him. But here, everything goes so much smoother. He seems much more comfortable and relaxed.

I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a trustworthy and skilled groomer!

This is a wonderful place!!
I have a very large golden doodle and he is always so handsome when we leave!!
The owner is especially experienced with nervous dogs both small and large!!
One of the best in Amsterdam!!

Karolina and her team are great! My pug cookie is coming to Vier Poten for at least 2 years and it’s always a positive experience, despite my pugs crazy temper! They are very warm and kind towards the animals and very nice people to deal with. Super recommended!
For poodles, I would go elsewhere.

Lina, my little Shih Tzu, has been coming here every month for over a year now. Karolina and her team are incredibly kind and attentive, always showing great care and patience with Lina, especially given Lina's lazy mood. They consistently make her look absolutely gorgeous after each visit. The level of professionalism and genuine love for pets that Karolina and her colleagues exhibit is truly commendable. I highly recommend this pet shop to anyone looking for top-notch grooming services for their furry friends!

I highly recommend this place. They are super friendly, and you can tell they love dogs. My dog is a bit nervous around other dogs, and I really appreciated the specialized attention they gave. They were very thoughtful in organizing the appointments to make sure it was less stressful.  We will definitely return! ❤️

We go a few times a year when my dog starts shedding (my dog is low maintenance otherwise). After a good bath and a brush out the amount of fur in the house gets down.
Karolina also clips my dog’s nails then. We’ve been going for a few years already and have had only positive experiences.

We have bringing our 2 shipoos for the last couple of years and we are always very pleased. They always leave smelling very fresh but not overly perfumed. Caroline loves our dogs and she’s very professional and also quick . Highly recommend!

Dear people,

I would like to warn everyone about this woman. I just walked past this grooming salon (Saturday, November 16, 2024) with my mother. We hadn't seen the salon before, so we stopped to take a peek at the dog clothes we saw hanging inside.
To our horror, we saw at that moment that this lady (from the cover photo) was giving a white dog—which looked like a Maltese (this was at 14:45) a hard punch to the hip, causing it to cry loudly in pain. We saw that the dog was already struggling beforehand because it was whimpering, and she probably hit it hard out of rage.

We got so angry about this that my mother stormed inside to speak to the woman. The woman was pale with shock and stammered in English that it was because the dog bit her, which is of course no excuse to hit a dog like that. The poor little animal was whimpering. Eventually, we took a photo of her salon outside, but she ran out saying we weren't allowed to take photos, which of course we didn't give a damn about.

If this involves your dog, please pick up your dog from there as soon as possible!! She is an animal abuser and should not be allowed to work with animals! Please share to warn other people!
